name: Elizabeth Paris
source:
"Ugh, this town is too small for me!"

A condescending young lady whose family once boasted a great fortune.
Although her family is no longer wealthy, she still looks down on others, making her unsusceptible to [url=/c87478]Vina[/url]'s bullying. Her demeanor is a defense mechanism from the embarrassment of falling down the social caste, but she has become close with [url=/c94034]Mercy[/url], to whom she is still snobbish.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request-2/chara/?page=elizabeth]official page[/url]]
